verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an inference engine. It has no built-in data store or insights feature, but its own CLI, server and built-in web UI let users run models, including vision models, over their own inputs. One hands-on report describes generating keywords and descriptions for personal photos this way. Missing for 10: any documented insights or suggestions feature that works over user data held in the product, automated or proactive analysis, document or dataset ingestion workflows, and first-party docs describing this use case.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
User used llama.cpp's vision support with Gemma3 4b to generate keywords/descriptions for trip photos, including basic OCR and context clues to identify photo locations
